Overview

Sample: 1A
Score: 9
The student earned all 9 points. In part (d) the student evidently stored more accurate intermediate values in the
calculator because the correct answer is presented.
Sample: 1B
Score: 6
The student earned 6 points: 1 point in part (a), 1 point in part (b), 1 point in part (c), and 3 points in part (d). In
part (a) the student’s work is correct. In part (b) the student earned the first point for ( ) 15 . A′ The units are
